name: Portuguese motorway tolls (portagens)
law: IMT, Taxas de Portagem de 2026: the toll of each lanço by class, set by the concession contracts and validated by IMT; class 2 (two axles, 1.1 m or higher at the front axle), 3 (three axles), 4 (more than three), excluding IVA (23%; 6% on the Lusoponte Tejo crossings, which charge northbound only). A trip pays each lanço it drives: each is a toll point in its middle, placed along the motorway by IMT's lengths at OpenStreetMap's junctions (extract of 2026-11-13). 19 lanços that couldn't be placed (branches, short runs, misfits) aren't charged. Only the concessions IMT's page lists (Brisa, Oeste, Brisal, Douro Litoral, Lusoponte, IP's A21).

sources.title: Polígrafo: Lusoponte bridge tolls carry the reduced 6% IVA
Decreto-Lei n.º 294/97 (Brisa concession bases), consolidated: tolls plus IVA

vehicles: Trucks of two or more axles (classes 2 to 4)
